A '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]; the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] journeyed to Lanteeb to destroy [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd's]] [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]].
